title: International Pizza Party
alt: IBSC students from different backgrounds sharing pizza and conversation
intro: A relaxed gathering gave students room to share experiences, exchange perspectives, and make new friends.
paragraphs: The International Pizza Party brought students from different countries and cultural backgrounds together on May 15, 2026. Held in Room R2102, the lunchtime gathering created a relaxed setting for cultural exchange within the IBSC community.

Over pizza, participants talked about their academic journeys and personal experiences. The conversation also opened space to discuss future plans and learn how other students approached their university lives.
The event centered on everyday connections. Informal conversation helped students build friendships and feel welcome, while celebrating the variety of cultures represented in the program.
headline: Good food, new friends, shared perspectives
teaser: The International Pizza Party creates space to meet, exchange ideas, and make connections.
facts: Focus: cultural exchange and community connection
